classification.question_topic: Sleep paralysis / in-between state after becoming lucid: being kicked out of dream into a black tunnel/void, freezing/suspension, pulsating body sensations, difficulty waking/unsticking

position.relative_to: experienced after being kicked out of a lucid dream; described as return of consciousness back into body through tunnel

qualities.raw_description: “return of my consciousness back into my body through a black tunnel”; “sometimes I get suspended in the tunnel and stay frozen there where I can’t fully wake up but I’m no longer in a dream/ just blackness is present”; “pulsating sensations massaging my body in this tunnel/void”; “cool but also spooky”; “have to focus really hard to get ‘Unstuck’ from the in between”

connections.qualities: Transition described as being “kicked out of the dream” and feeling consciousness returning “back into my body through a black tunnel”; sometimes gets “suspended” and “frozen” and must focus to get “Unstuck” to fully wake.

boundaries.description: In the tunnel/in-between state: “just blackness is present”; feels stuck between dream and waking and has to focus to get unstuck.

interactions.description: After becoming lucid, the dream ends/kicks them out; they experience moving through a black tunnel/void and sometimes become suspended/frozen and try to fully wake by focusing hard to get “Unstuck.”
Experiences pulsating sensations described as “massaging my body” while in the tunnel/void.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post describes a recurring post-lucid transition state rather than a specific Mall World setting. Spatial data extracted is limited to the described ‘black tunnel/void’ and being suspended/frozen within it. No discrete dream locations (mall/school/hotel) are provided.
